message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: pytest

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/*"
      - "pymc_extras/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - "setup.py"
      - "pyproject.toml"
      - "conda-envs/**"
      - "codecov.yml"

# Cancels all previous workflow runs for pull requests that have not completed.
concurrency:
  # The concurrency group contains the workflow name and the branch name for pull requests
  # or the commit hash for any other events.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Bump CACHE_NUMBER to force a one-time refresh of the cached conda environments.
env:
  CACHE_NUMBER: 1

jobs:
  pre-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      # no-commit-to-branch fails on push to main since HEAD is main. CI lints,
      # it doesn't commit, so skip that one hook.
      - uses: pre-commit/action@2c7b3805fd2a0fd8c1884dcaebf91fc102a13ecd  # v3.0.1
        env:
          SKIP: no-commit-to-branch

  ubuntu:
    needs: pre-commit
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        linker: [cvm, numba]
        python-version: ["3.12"]
        # Shards are balanced by measured runtime under numba, about 12-14 minutes each.
        test-subset:
          - tests/model
          - tests/distributions tests/statespace/core/test_forward_sampling.py
          - tests --ignore tests/model --ignore tests/statespace --ignore tests/distributions --ignore tests/inference/pathfinder
          - tests/statespace/models/test_VARMAX.py tests/statespace/models/test_SARIMAX.py
          - tests/statespace/models tests/statespace/core/test_statespace.py --ignore tests/statespace/models/test_VARMAX.py --ignore tests/statespace/models/test_SARIMAX.py
          - tests/statespace/filters/test_kalman_filter.py
          - tests/statespace --ignore tests/statespace/models --ignore tests/statespace/core/test_statespace.py --ignore tests/statespace/filters/test_kalman_filter.py --ignore tests/statespace/core/test_forward_sampling.py
      fail-fast: false
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      TEST_SUBSET: ${{ matrix.test-subset }}
      PYTENSOR_FLAGS: linker=${{ matrix.linker }}
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -leo pipefail {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@f457c30a868e4760d3a6fcea5f25dc655b8edf39  # v3.2.1
        with:
          environment-file: conda-envs/environment-test.yml
          create-args: >-
            python=${{matrix.python-version}}
          environment-name: pymc-extras-test
          init-shell: bash
          cache-environment: true
          cache-environment-key: pymc-extras-test-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('conda-envs/environment-test.yml') }}-${{ env.CACHE_NUMBER }}
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install pymc-extras
        run: |
          pip install -e ".[dev]" --no-deps

          python --version
          pip check
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest --color=yes -vv --cov=pymc_extras --cov-append --cov-report=xml --cov-report term --durations=50 $TEST_SUBSET
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@fb8b3582c8e4def4969c97caa2f19720cb33a72f  # v7.0.0
        with:
          env_vars: TEST_SUBSET
          name: ${{ matrix.os }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false
  windows:
    needs: pre-commit
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest]
        linker: [cvm, numba]
        python-version: ["3.12"]
        test-subset:
          - tests/model
          # Windows runs one end-to-end statespace workflow per model class; the full statespace
          # suite runs on Ubuntu.
          - >-
            tests/statespace/models/test_ETS.py::test_ets_workflow
            tests/statespace/models/test_VARMAX.py::test_varmax_workflow
            tests/statespace/models/test_SARIMAX.py::test_sarimax_workflow
            tests/statespace/models/test_DFM.py::test_dfm_workflow
          - tests/distributions
          # Pathfinder spawns workers on Windows, which rebuild their compiled functions, so it
          # takes as long as the rest of this shard combined.
          - tests/inference/pathfinder
          - tests --ignore tests/model --ignore tests/statespace --ignore tests/distributions --ignore tests/inference/pathfinder
      fail-fast: false
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      TEST_SUBSET: ${{ matrix.test-subset }}
      PYTENSOR_FLAGS: linker=${{ matrix.linker }}
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: cmd /C call {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@f457c30a868e4760d3a6fcea5f25dc655b8edf39  # v3.2.1
        with:
          environment-file: conda-envs/environment-test.yml
          # gxx 16.2.0 on conda-forge win-64 cannot link (ld cannot find dllcrt2.o);
          # see conda-forge/ctng-compilers-feedstock#229 and m2w64-sysroot-feedstock#23.
          create-args: >-
            python=${{matrix.python-version}}
            gxx_win-64=16.1
          environment-name: pymc-extras-test
          init-shell: cmd.exe
          cache-environment: true
          cache-environment-key: pymc-extras-test-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('conda-envs/environment-test.yml') }}-${{ env.CACHE_NUMBER }}
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install pymc-extras
        run: |
          pip install -e ".[dev]" --no-deps

          python --version
      - name: Run tests
        # This job uses a cmd shell, therefore the environment variable syntax is different!
        # The ">-" in the next line replaces newlines with spaces (see https://stackoverflow.com/a/66809682).
        run: >-
          python -m pytest --color=yes -vv --cov=pymc_extras --cov-append --cov-report=xml --cov-report term --durations=50 %TEST_SUBSET%
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@fb8b3582c8e4def4969c97caa2f19720cb33a72f  # v7.0.0
        with:
          env_vars: TEST_SUBSET
          name: ${{ matrix.os }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  all_tests:
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [ pre-commit, ubuntu, windows ]
    steps:
      - name: Check all tests pass
        if: ${{ needs.pre-commit.result != 'success' || needs.ubuntu.result != 'success' || needs.windows.result != 'success' }}
        run: exit 1
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `pip install -e ".[dev]"` on every Ubuntu and Windows matrix run but caches only the conda environment, not the pip download cache. The retrieved forked pytest-workflow experiment shows adding `actions/cache@v4` for `~/.cache/pip` keyed by `hashFiles('pyproject.toml')` with restore keys, which is directly applicable because `pyproject.toml` is present and pinned as the cache input. This preserves all test shards, coverage collection, and required checks; it only avoids re-downloading pip wheels/build-isolation packages on warm runs, with no new network targets, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or permission changes.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
